note: Behaviours where the Rust build intentionally differs from the Go build moai.old. Each entry names a case of tests/diff_go.rs, says in what the two differ, and gives the reason. The test checks that the difference is still there, so a stale entry fails.

differences.go: three lines starting with the model and the Go version, then CW/5H/7D bars, then folder, branch and git counts
differences.rust: a role segment, the model, the Rust version, the branch and one CTX bar
differences.reason: the Rust status line is its own design (card #2350, design 2383); only the reading of the payload is kept

differences.go: `moai hook pre-tool` answers an allow decision on stdout (`hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision` = `allow`) in a folder with no MoAI settings, and creates a `.moai` folder in the current folder
differences.rust: `moai hook pre-tool` prints nothing on stdout; stderr says it ignored a Go-generation hook call
differences.reason: the Rust build does not run Go hooks (its hooks are `hook-dispatch --host H --event E`, card #2391); nothing is blocked

differences.go: `moai hook pre-tool` denies `rm -rf /` with `permissionDecisionReason` = `Dangerous command blocked: removal of protected path "/"`
differences.rust: `moai hook-dispatch --host claude --event tool-preflight` denies the same command with the same `hookEventName` and `permissionDecision`, and its own reason text (`MoAI tool-preflight: rm aimed at the root, ...`)
differences.reason: the decision shape is the kept protection (src/hook_engine.rs); the wording is the Rust build's own

differences.go: `moai hook pre-tool` answers an explicit allow decision (`permissionDecision` = `allow`) for `ls`
differences.rust: `moai hook-dispatch --host claude --event tool-preflight` prints nothing for `ls` and exits 0
differences.reason: the Rust build speaks only when it refuses; silence lets the command run (card #2391)
